text:
alex: FYI CVE posted for fastproto (serialization lib) used by tokenizer-service. PoC causes crafted payload to trigger heap corruption on parse. Link from security-bot. :rotating_light:

security-bot: [CVE-2026-12345] https://security.example.com/cves/CVE-2026-12345 fastproto v0.9.1 - v0.9.3 unsafe parsing. Patch: v0.9.4. Recommended: upgrade and run fuzz-detect script.

ops-raj: Impact assessment: tokenizer-service and any sidecar that calls fastproto directly (tokenizer-prod, tokenizer-staging). No evidence of exploit in logs so far.

emily: Quick mitigation plan: 1) pin fastproto to 0.9.4 and build new images for tokenizer-service; 2) deploy canary to staging in 2h; 3) prod canary 8h; 4) full prod 24h.

sre-dan: I'll open a deploy runbook and kick off a canary in us-east-1. Will enable extra monitoring (heap/oom, core dumps) and abort on >1 core dump in 10m.

alex: Developers: update requirements.txt to `fastproto==0.9.4` and add a CI gate: `python -c "import fastproto; assert fastproto.__version__ >= '0.9.4'"`

security-bot: Detection script (run against staging):
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging-tokenizer.redwood.ai/parse \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' \
  --data-binary @exploit_payload.bin | hexdump -C
```
Look for crashes, non-zero exit, or stack traces.

compliance-rosa: Please capture a note in the security register with PR links and rotated secrets if any. We need timestamps for the audit.

ops-raj: Created ticket SEC-2026-78 and assigned to @emily and @sre-dan. Patch PRs should reference this ticket.

emily: Can confirm build succeeds with v0.9.4 locally. Pushing PR now.

sre-dan: Canary up +5m: no crashes, memory stable. Proceeding to 10% traffic.

alex: Good job. After full rollout, please post closure summary with timeline, PRs, and any rotated keys. :thumbsup:
